notificationBody: Choose one focused Patternly practice session.
permissionDeniedDetail: Allow notifications in device settings to use reminders.
permissionGrantedDetail: Patternly can show local practice reminders.
permissionCheckingDetail: Patternly is still reading notification permission.
permissionUndeterminedDetail: Allow local notifications before setting a reminder.
reminderDisableErrorTitle: Reminder could not be turned off
reminderDisableErrorDetail: Try turning off the reminder again.
reminderTimeInvalid: Use a valid 24-hour time, for example 20:00.
reminderNote: This device follows the preferred days of the current track.
loadingDetail: Reading reminder settings and notification permission.
loadErrorDetail: Patternly could not read reminder settings. Try again.
requestErrorTitle: Notification permission could not be checked
openSettingsErrorDetail: Patternly could not open device settings. Open Settings manually to change notifications.
sheetIntro: Choose one time or set each preferred day separately.
separateTimesDetail: Set a time for each selected day.
goalPaused: The goal is paused. No reminders are scheduled.
noActiveGoal: Set an active goal to schedule reminders.
noActiveTrack: Select a track to schedule reminders.
noGoalDays: Add preferred days to your goal before setting reminder times.
planScheduleEmpty: No accepted plan slots are available.
pendingDetail: Your plan is saved. Patternly will try to schedule these reminders again.
missingTrackDetail: Select a track before enabling plan reminders.
missingGoalDetail: Set an active goal before enabling plan reminders.
missingPlanDetail: Accept a learning plan before enabling reminders.
identityMismatchDetail: Review the current plan before enabling reminders.
goalPausedDetail: Resume the goal before enabling reminders.
planPausedDetail: Resume the learning plan before enabling reminders.
planCompletedDetail: This plan is complete, so no reminders are scheduled.
noSlotsDetail: Add sessions to the accepted plan before enabling reminders.
timezoneMismatchDetail: Use the plan time zone on this device before enabling reminders.
schedulerFailureDetail: Your plan is saved. Try scheduling its reminders again.
concurrentChangeDetail: The plan changed while reminders were being updated. Try again.
